fact.en: Confusing Bimbisara with Bindusara (Mauryan dynasty). Bimbisara is the founder of Haryanka.
fact.hi: Confusing Bimbisara with Bindusara (Mauryan dynasty). Bimbisara is the founder of Haryanka.

fact.en: Assuming Magadha was the only powerful Mahajanapada; ignore Avanti and Kosala as major contemporary rivals.
fact.hi: Assuming Magadha was the only powerful Mahajanapada; ignore Avanti and Kosala as major contemporary rivals.

fact.en: Attributing the permanent capital shift to Pataliputra to Bimbisara; it was Udayin.
